title: Plasma Computer Memory (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: Bits are stored configurations of plasma, like delay lines and core memory before them. The Signature extension defines the plasma memory cell as a standardized unit: a 100-micron vortex holding 8 bits with a specified retention, refresh, and read energy. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
capabilities: Store bits as persistent plasma structures and patterns
Write and read via probes, waves, and field pulses
Hold data against collisional decay with refresh
Organize cache, main, and archive plasma tiers
Hand stored state to logic on demand
